support_claim: Commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Robotics Ltd (the CRM operating name tied to HEL-441) and Helion Robotics Limited (the billing name) are the same legal entity.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity rather than mere compatibility. The packet links crm:HEL-441 to Helion Robotics Ltd via the CRM row and billing:Helion Robotics Limited via invoices, and commercial_notes paragraph 1 directly asserts that those names refer to the same legal entity; no observation preserves alternate live candidates or states that identity cannot be established.
